SNARKY.definition: Disdainfully or ironically humorous; scornful and mocking.
SNARKY.example: His rebellion is the bitter, sardonic laughter of all great satirists"- Frank Schoenberner.

RANK.gloss: a row or line of people standing abreast of one another
RANK.definition: A row or line of people (especially soldiers or police) standing abreast of one another.
RANK.example: The entrance was guarded by ranks of policemen.

YARN.gloss: the act of giving an account describing incidents or a course of events
YARN.definition: The act of giving an account describing incidents or a course of events.

YANK.gloss: pull, or move with a sudden movement
YANK.definition: Pull, or move with a sudden movement.
YANK.example: He turned the handle and jerked the door open.

ANY.gloss: one or some or every or all without specification
ANY.definition: One or some or every or all without specification.
ANY.example: Give me any peaches you don't want.

SAY.example: He said that he wanted to marry her.

ASK.gloss: make a request or demand for something to somebody
ASK.definition: Make a request or demand for something to somebody.
ASK.example: She asked him for a loan.

SKY.gloss: the atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth
SKY.definition: The atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth.

RAY.definition: A column of light (as from a beacon).

ARK.gloss: a boat built by Noah to save his family and animals from the flood
ARK.definition: A boat built by Noah to save his family and animals from the flood.
